question: What is the currency of Bangladesh, a neighbouring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**taka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taka:-**

 
 
• **It is the official currency of Bangladesh. **
 
• It is subdivided into 100 poisha.
 
• The taka was introduced in 1972, after the independence of Bangladesh from Pakistan.
 
• The currency is issued by the Bangladesh Bank.
 
• The taka is a symbol of Bangladesh's national identity and economic progress.
 
• It is also a reminder of the country's struggle for independence.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kyat:-**

 
 
• **It is the official currency of Myanmar (Burma). **
 
• It is subdivided into 100 pyas. The kyat was introduced in 1952, after the independence of Myanmar from the British Empire.
 
• The currency is issued by the Central Bank of Myanmar.
 
 
 
• **Ngultrum (BTN):-**
 
 
• **It is the official currency of Bhutan. **
 
• It is subdivided into 100 chetrums.
 
• The ngultrum was introduced in 1974, and it is currently pegged to the Indian rupee at par.
 
 
 
• **Yuan:-**
 
 
• **It is the official currency of the People's Republic of China (PRC).**
 
• It is the basic unit of the renminbi (RMB), which literally means "people's currency".
